mapper.sql: id, tenant_id AS tenantId, recipient_user_id AS recipientUserId, digest_date AS digestDate, status, item_count AS itemCount, attempt_count AS attemptCount, next_attempt_at AS nextAttemptAt, lease_until AS leaseUntil, claim_token AS claimToken, send_attempted_at AS sendAttemptedAt, unknown_outcome_count AS unknownOutcomeCount, failure_category AS failureCategory, last_error AS lastError, provider_message_id AS providerMessageId, created_at AS createdAt, sent_at AS sentAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_digest_email SET status = 'FAILED_RETRYABLE', next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, failure_category = #{failureCategory}, last_error = #{lastError}, send_attempted_at = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND claim_token = #{claimToken}

UPDATE notification_digest_email SET status = 'FAILED_PERMANENT', failure_category = #{failureCategory}, last_error = #{lastError}, send_attempted_at = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND claim_token = #{claimToken}

UPDATE notification_digest_email SET status = #{status}, failure_category = #{failureCategory}, send_attempted_at = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND claim_token = #{claimToken}

UPDATE notification_digest_email SET status = 'SKIPPED_PREFERENCE', failure_category = 'PERMANENT_PREFERENCE', claim_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} AND ( status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED_RETRYABLE', 'COLLECTING') OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now})) )
